reports.title: Audrey Daws
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: We have made a number of changes to the handover process, both in relation to medical and nursing procedures.
promises.summary: Introduced new handover record and daily sheets to improve communication.

concerns.quote: The need for Mrs Daws to undergo a chest X- ray and for the result to be checked appears to have been lost as medical staff have changed at the end/start of consecutive shifts
A chest X-ray should have been ordered at the time of Mrs Daws admission into the emergency department
once the X-ray was performed, the result was not seen by medical staff for over 24 hours

concerns.quote: There was a delay of 5 days in the formal reporting of the original X-ray

concerns.quote: There was a further delay of 2 to 3 days in the obtaining of a second X-ray

The Consultant responsible for Mr [name redacted] care did not know of Hospital guidance that an MRI should be obtained where a first X-ray is inconclusive and/or the patient complains of pain or fails to mobilise
